description:
This 2013 Chrysler Town & Country Touring is a well-equipped family vehicle ready to serve your transportation needs with practicality and comfort.

- 2nd & 3rd Row Window Shades
- Uconnect 430 CD/DVD/MP3/HDD with 40GB Hard Drive
- 6.5 Touch Screen Display
- Uconnect Voice Command with Bluetooth
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats
- Power Liftgate
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Rear Air Conditioning
- Power Driver Seat
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Alloy Wheels
- Front Fog Lights
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control

The black exterior presents a classic appearance, while the Touring trim provides a thoughtful selection of comfort and convenience features. The 3.6L 6-cylinder engine delivers power through a 6-speed automatic transmission, achieving 17 city and 25 highway miles per gallon to balance performance with efficiency.

Inside, the Touring trim offers leather-trimmed front bucket seats with a driver's seat-mounted armrest for added support during daily driving. The climate control system includes automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C and rear air conditioning to maintain comfort for all passengers. The Uconnect 430 infotainment system features a 6.5-inch touch screen display, Bluetooth connectivity, and voice command capabilities, allowing hands-free control of your phone and audio entertainment.

Safety features are integrated throughout the cabin, including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, front and rear anti-roll bars, and electronic stability control with traction control. The ParkView rear back-up camera provides visibility when reversing, and the rear window defroster ensures clear sightlines in various weather conditions.

The practical cabin layout accommodates up to seven passengers with front bucket seats and a split-folding rear seat, complemented by a reclining third-row seat. The 2nd and 3rd row window shades offer climate control and privacy for rear passengers. A power liftgate makes loading and unloading cargo convenient, supported by an alloy wheel set mounted on a front-wheel-drive platform with independent front suspension for a smooth ride.

Visit our showroom to experience the comfort and family-friendly design this Town & Country Touring offers for your daily commute and weekend adventures.

Under the hood sits a 3.6L Boxer H6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission, engineered for the road ahead. The all-wheel-drive system provides confident traction in varied weather conditions, while the suspension delivers a balanced ride suitable for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. With 18 city MPG and 25 highway MPG, this Outback balances capability with reasonable fuel efficiency.

The cabin reflects the Limited trim's commitment to comfort and convenience. Heated front seats warm you on chilly mornings, while the dual front zone climate control ensures passenger comfort. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats let you find your ideal driving position. An overhead console and front center armrest with storage keep essentials within reach, and the illuminated entry welcomes you in low-light conditions.

Technology integrations enhance daily driving. The voice-activated GPS navigation system with its 8" touch screen simplifies route planning, while Bluetooth connectivity allows hands-free phone calls and audio streaming. The AM/FM stereo with single-disc CD and DVD player, combined with the 440-watt Harman Kardon amplifier and nine speakers, delivers quality sound whether you're enjoying satellite radio, music files, or podcasts through the aux input jack and USB port.

The anti-whiplash front head restraints, four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars, and electronic stability control work together to promote confident vehicle control. ABS brakes with brake assist and four-wheel disc brakes give you responsive stopping power when you need it.

Practicality shines through thoughtful details. The rear vision camera aids parking and reversing maneuvers, while the auto-dimming rear view mirror with compass and HomeLink adds convenience. Splash guards and a rear bumper cover protect your investment, and the roof rack accommodates cargo carriers for expanded storage. The split folding rear seat quickly adapts your cargo area to suit your needs.

This 2012 Subaru Outback 3.6R Limited stands ready to support your active lifestyle with proven durability and thoughtful features designed for real-world use. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this capable wagon firsthand.

Introducing the 2027 Ford Expedition Max Active, a full-size SUV built to handle whatever your lifestyle demands with confidence and capability.

- EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- 4WD with 2-Speed Automatic and Neutral Towing capability
- Equipment Group 202A Touring Package with premium amenities
- 2nd Row Power-Folding Captain's Chairs with 7-passenger seating
- Heated front captain's chairs and heated steering wheel
- 20" carbonized gray bright machined aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 with Intersection Assist and Lane Change Assist

- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow with Integrated Trailer Brake Control

- Dual power-folding mirrors with autofold and memory settings

This Expedition Max combines spacious three-row seating with intelligent design features that enhance daily driving. The captain's chairs in the second row provide comfort for your passengers, while the power-folding configuration allows easy access to the third row when needed. The heated front seats and steering wheel deliver warmth during colder months, and the automatic temperature control keeps the cabin comfortable for all rows.

Advanced driver assistance technology enhances your confidence on every journey. Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 provides lane-keeping assistance and intersection detection, while the included 90-Day BlueCruise trial gives you access to hands-free driving on compatible highways. The rearview camera and available safety features help you navigate with awareness in all driving conditions.

The Gray exterior presents a sophisticated appearance that complements the Expedition Max's commanding presence on the road. Interior appointments reflect attention to detail, with cloth captain's chairs, multiple storage solutions, and intuitive controls for entertainment and climate management. The power-folding sideview mirrors and Ford Split Gate enhance convenience for parking and loading.

Power and efficiency work together in this vehicle. The EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine delivers the capability you need, while the 10-Speed Automatic transmission optimizes performance and fuel economy. Four-wheel drive with 2-Speed Automatic transmission and Neutral Towing provides the control necessary for varied terrain and towing situations.

Entertainment and connectivity keep you engaged throughout your drives. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L service offers extensive audio options, while Google Maps Navigation provides reliable route guidance. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone seamlessly connected to the vehicle's display.

The black exterior presents a refined appearance, while the V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers reliable performance for both highway and city driving. With an EPA rating of 19 city and 26 highway miles per gallon, this front-wheel-drive minivan balances power and efficiency for everyday use.

The spacious interior accommodates up to eight passengers with cloth seating throughout and front bucket seats that provide individual comfort. The third row features a reclining split-bench design, allowing you to adjust seating for passengers or fold the seats down for additional cargo space. Carpeted floor mats protect the cabin, while mud guards shield the exterior from road debris.

Climate control extends throughout the vehicle with standard air conditioning and dedicated rear air conditioning to keep all passengers comfortable regardless of weather. The rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in challenging conditions, while the fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature and auto high-beam capability enhance safety and convenience.

Technology integration is seamless with both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, giving you access to navigation, messaging, and entertainment through your smartphone. The AM/FM audio system with six speakers, steering wheel mounted controls, and an outside temperature display keeps critical information at your fingertips.

Safety features include four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front and side impact airbags, knee and overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Electronic stability control and traction control work together with four-wheel independent suspension to maintain composure on varied road surfaces. A backup camera aids in reversing and parking maneuvers with confidence.

This 2024 Carnival LX SEAT PACKAGE combines practicality, space, and modern conveniences into one comprehensive family vehicle. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the thoughtful layout and comfortable ride that make this minivan an excellent choice for your transportation needs.

description:
This 2021 Ram 1500 TRX represents a commanding presence on the road, delivering the performance and capability you demand from a premium truck.

- 6.2L Supercharged HEMI V8 SRT engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with adaptive suspension for superior handling and control
- TRX Level 1 Equipment Group with premium leather and suede appointments
- Dual-pane panoramic sunroof with dome dual LED reading lamps
- Heated and power-adjustable front seats with 8-way power adjustment
- Heated leather and suede flat-bottom steering wheel with power adjustment
- Uconnect 12 with navigation and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- HARMAN/KARDON 19-speaker premium sound system
- MOPAR spray-in bedliner with 4 adjustable cargo tie-down hooks
- MOPAR off-road style running boards and deployable bed step

- ParkView rear back-up camera with integrated rear window defroster
- Remote start system and universal garage door opener
- Rear underseat compartment storage with full-length premium console
- Black exterior with body-color door handles and accent lighting throughout

The luxury appointments throughout this TRX elevate the driving experience with meticulous attention to detail. The wrapped assist handles, illuminated vanity mirrors, and premium IP bezel with LED ambient lighting create an upscale interior environment. Rain-sensitive windshield wipers and auto high-beam headlights enhance convenience, while the integrated emergency communication system through SiriusXM Guardian provides added peace of mind.

This truck combines capability with refinement, offering independent front suspension and electronic stability control that work seamlessly with the adaptive suspension system to deliver confident handling. The all-wheel disc braking system with ABS and brake assist ensures responsive stopping power, while the comprehensive airbag system including front and side impact protection keeps you secure.

The exterior styling makes a statement with the TRX-specific graphics package, running boards, and rambar. The 18-inch black paint and polish aluminum wheels complement the black exterior, and the front fog lights paired with fully automatic headlights provide excellent visibility in all conditions. The rear step bumper and ParkView camera make navigation and parking straightforward.

With modern technology seamlessly integrated throughout, this truck serves as both a daily driver and weekend adventure companion. The SiriusXM 360L satellite radio keeps you entertained on every journey, while the trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

This 2021 Ram 1500 TRX is ready to deliver the performance and luxury you've been looking for. We invite you to experience it firsthand at our showroom and discuss how it can become part of your driving life.

Meet the 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4 a heavy-duty truck built for those who demand capability without compromise. This white diesel powerhouse combines serious workhorse performance with premium comfort features designed for both job sites and everyday driving.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Class IV Tow Hitch with Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert
- Spray-In Bed Liner with GMC Logo
- Heated and Cooled Seats with Heated Steering Wheel
- BOSE Premium Audio System with SiriusXM Satellite Radio

The Sierra 2500HD AT4 is engineered to deliver. The Duramax diesel engine produces 470 horsepower and generates the torque needed for serious towing and hauling. The 10-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly with 4WD to give you control on any terrain, whether you're navigating mountain passes or downtown streets. The Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert and integrated trailering system take the guesswork out of hauling, making this truck as smart as it is strong.

Inside, comfort meets functionality. The heated and cooled leather seats adjust to your preferences, while the heated steering wheel keeps you comfortable on cold mornings. The BOSE audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio transforms your cab into a premium listening environment. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected without the clutter of cables, and the color touchscreen provides intuitive control over navigation, music, and truck settings.

Safety is integrated throughout this truck's design. The HD Surround Vision system provides a complete 360-degree view, eliminating blind spots. Lane Keep Assist helps you maintain your position, while Forward Collision Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking provide extra protection. Parking sensors make maneuvering easier, whether you're backing up to a loading dock or navigating a tight parking space.

The AT4 package adds genuine off-road capability with an off-road suspension, 2-Speed Active Transfer Case, and Hill Descent Control. The spray-in bed liner protects your investment, while premium wheels and winter amenities prepare you for harsh conditions. Engine block heater, exhaust brake, and a 220-amp alternator ensure reliability in demanding situations.

This truck comes with one owner and a clean CARFAX history, demonstrating careful ownership and maintenance. The 100-Year or 100,000-Mile Power-Train Warranty provides peace of mind and backed by GMC's commitment to durability. With a comprehensive feature set and unwavering reliability, the 2025 Sierra 2500HD AT4 is ready to work as hard as you do, today and for years to come.

The single-speed automatic transmission paired with the electric motor provides smooth, responsive acceleration while maintaining the truck's signature capability. With all-wheel drive and four-wheel independent suspension, this Lightning handles various road conditions with confidence.

The Platinum trim elevates your ownership experience with premium Nirvana leather bucket seats in front, heated and ventilated front seating surfaces, and a heated rear bench seat for passenger comfort. The power moonroof provides an open-air quality to the cabin, while the SYNC 4A infotainment system with enhanced voice recognition keeps you connected and in control.

Only Ford Models, Such as the Mustang MachE, and F150 Lightning, Can Become EV Certified.

Practical features include the hard folding tonneau cover that protects your cargo while maintaining the truck's clean lines, the tough bed spray-in bedliner for durability, and the mobile power cord that works with both 120V and 240V charging options. The rear-view backup camera provides visibility when maneuvering, while the tray-style floor liner protects the cabin from daily wear.

This one-owner vehicle has been thoroughly inspected and comes with the remainder of the factory warranty still applying. The clean Carfax history and Ford Gold Certification affirm its condition and reliability. At 24,606 miles, this truck remains well-maintained and ready to serve your needs.

The 2025 F-150 Lightning Platinum delivers the truck performance you expect with the efficiency and lower operating costs of electric power.

Welcome to Findlay Kia on Sahara Ave in Las Vegas. All of our vehicles are hand picked and inspected for your piece of mind.

- Navigation System
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats

The 2027 Kia Telluride SX delivers capable performance with its 2.5L turbocharged engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission, providing responsive acceleration and smooth shifting for your daily drive. The front-wheel-drive configuration ensures confident handling across various road conditions.

This three-row crossover is designed with family comfort in mind. The heated and ventilated front bucket seats provide personalized comfort control, while the spacious cabin accommodates up to seven passengers. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seating give you flexibility when you need extra cargo space or additional passenger room.

Your daily commute benefits from modern conveniences throughout the cabin. The dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning ensures all passengers stay comfortable regardless of season. Power windows, steering, and door mirrors are standard, along with remote keyless entry and HomeLink garage door transmitter integration.

Navigation and entertainment are handled seamlessly with the integrated Navigation System and Apple CarPlay & Android Auto compatibility. The 14-speaker audio system with SiriusXM provides quality sound whether you're on the highway or in the city. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Safety remains paramount with comprehensive standard features including dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag protection. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes, and low tire pressure warning work together to help prevent accidents. The rearview camera and 911 Connect emergency communication system add extra layers of security.

The White exterior is complemented by 20" alloy wheels and body-color bumpers that give the Telluride SX a refined appearance. The power moonroof lets natural light into the cabin, while the power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient.

We invite you to visit our showroom to see this 2027 Kia Telluride SX in person and experience the quality we stand behind. Price includes $499 of dealer added accessories.

This 2022 Ram 3500 Limited delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a premium heavy-duty truck. With its Cummins 6.7L turbodiesel engine, four-wheel drive, and comprehensive towing package, this vehicle is engineered to handle demanding work while maintaining the comfort of daily driving.

- 360 Camera with Surround View
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Backup Camera with Cargo View
- Blind Spot Sensors
- Lane-Keeping Assist
- Heated and Cooled Leather Seats
- Navigation System with 12 Touchscreen
- Remote Start
- 17-Speaker Harman Kardon Premium Sound
- Trailer Reverse Guidance
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Towing Prep
- 50-Gallon Fuel Tank
- Dual Alternators (440 Amps)
- One Owner with Clean History

The Limited trim brings genuine wood accents throughout the cabin, combining durability with an upscale atmosphere. Premium leather seating with heating and cooling functions ensures comfort during long drives, while the power-adjustable driver and passenger seats with memory settings provide personalized support. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of convenience for colder months.

Technology throughout this truck reflects modern standards. The Uconnect 5 navigation system with its 12-inch display integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone connectivity. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L keeps you entertained, while the integrated voice command system with Bluetooth hands-free calling keeps you focused on the road.

Safety features protect you and your passengers with full-speed forward collision warning, adaptive steering, electronic stability control, and six airbags. The digital rearview mirror and blind spot monitoring enhance visibility, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights adapt to changing conditions automatically.

The Cummins turbodiesel engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission delivers the torque you need for towing and hauling, supported by the 5th wheel/gooseneck towing prep group and comprehensive engine cooling system. The 50-gallon fuel tank extends your range, while dual 730-amp maintenance-free batteries ensure reliable starting in all conditions.

With just over 74,000 miles on the odometer, this single-owner truck has been well-maintained and represents an excellent value for buyers seeking a capable heavy-duty truck with genuine luxury appointments.

The moonroof with tilt-up and slide functionality adds an open-air dimension to drives, complementing the navigation-ready design. The 17 unique 7-spoke off-road alloy wheels provide capable traction while maintaining a purposeful appearance. With city and highway fuel economy ratings of 16 and 19 MPG respectively, this 4Runner balances capability with practical efficiency.

This 2023 Toyota 4Runner TRD Off-Road Premium represents a well-equipped vehicle ready for your next chapter, whether that involves daily commuting or weekend adventures.

Heated driver and front outboard passenger seats provide warmth on cold mornings, and dual-zone automatic climate control ensures individualized comfort for all occupants. Connectivity and convenience features throughout this truck make ownership seamless. Remote vehicle starter capability lets you warm or cool the cabin before arrival, while the EZ Lift power tailgate reduces everyday effort. Remote keyless entry, power windows, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep essential functions at your fingertips. A 120-volt bed-mounted outlet provides power for tools and equipment, supporting both work and lifestyle needs.

Safety technology is integrated throughout the vehicle. Automatic emergency braking with front pedestrian braking capability helps prevent accidents, while lane keep assist and lane departure warning provide additional confidence on highways. A rearview camera offers enhanced visibility when backing up, and the stability control and traction control systems work continuously to maintain secure handling.

With an EPA rating of 21 city and 23 highway MPG, this 3.0L I6 delivers respectable fuel efficiency for its class. The 10-speed automatic transmission optimizes performance across a wide range of driving conditions, while the 4WD system and auto-locking rear differential provide traction when needed. The suspension package and hill descent control contribute to capable off-road performance when the road less traveled calls.

This Silverado 1500 LT Trail Boss offers practical functionality, modern technology, and dependable performance everything you need in a full-size truck. We invite you to visit and experience how its well-considered features and solid engineering can fit your lifestyle.

Emergency communication through SYNC 3 911 Assist provides added peace of mind.

The gray exterior presents a professional appearance, complemented by magnetic-painted front and rear bumpers, a black mesh grille with magnetic surround, and 17 magnetic-painted sport aluminum wheels. The sport appearance package, including a sport box decal and magnetic-painted fender vents, gives this Ranger distinctive character. The manual-sliding rear window provides convenient ventilation and loading flexibility.

This 2017 Acura TLX with the 3.5L V6 and Technology Package represents a well-maintained sedan designed for drivers who value performance, comfort, and sophistication.

- Clean Carfax with no accidents
- ELS Studio Premium Audio System with 10 speakers
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM
- Navigation System
- Rear backup camera
- Power moonroof
- Heated front seats with perforated Milano premium leather
- 18-inch aluminum-alloy wheels
- Lane Departure Warning System

The exterior features a sleek gray finish complemented by body-color bumpers and heated power door mirrors with integrated turn signal indicators. The 18-inch aluminum-alloy wheels provide both style and durability, while rain-sensing wipers and delay-off headlights add practical convenience to your daily drives.

The interior welcomes you with heated front bucket seats trimmed in perforated Milano premium leather, offering comfort and refinement. The driver's seat includes power adjustment with memory settings, while the power passenger seat ensures every occupant finds their ideal position. Technology integrates seamlessly throughout the cabin with the navigation system guiding your route, while the premium ELS audio system with 10 speakers delivers exceptional clarity through SiriusXM, AM/FM, and CD playback. Steering-wheel-mounted audio controls keep entertainment at your fingertips, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter simplifies your arrival home.

The backup camera, rear park assist, lane change alert, and rear cross traffic alert give you visibility and awareness in challenging driving situations.

Connectivity keeps you engaged without distraction. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrate your smartphone, while Bluetooth phone connectivity and steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow safe operation while focusing on the road. The OnStar system provides emergency communication capabilities and connected services.

Whether you're managing daily responsibilities or planning weekend adventures, this 2019 Equinox LT offers the combination of capability, comfort, and technology that supports your lifestyle.
